text: Assumption: The property "Non Reentrant for the same device" requires caller-side synchronization in case of concurrent access to the same controller — is this correct?

norm: the property non reentrant for the same device requires caller side synchronization in case of concurrent access to the same controller
assumption: The property "Non Reentrant for the same device" requires caller-side synchronization in case of concurrent access to the same controller.
rationale: The specification extract defines the reentrancy behavior, but describes no driver-internal locking mechanisms.
